associations.rationale: The type directly states that the covariant subspace has complex dimension two, establishing the dimensional part of the claimed model.
The type directly states that the covariant subspace is preserved by every right-regular action, establishing that it is a Q8-subrepresentation.
The type directly states that every invariant submodule contained in the covariant subspace is zero or the whole subspace, which is its irreducibility.
